subject:
[PROPOSAL] Helm chart: triggerer.sets and dagProcessor.sets (per-team
 instances for multi-team)

messages.subject:
[PROPOSAL] Helm chart: triggerer.sets and dagProcessor.sets (per-team
 instances for multi-team)
messages.body:
Hi all,

I'd like to propose adding `sets` to the triggerer and dag processor in
the Helm chart, following the existing `workers.celery.sets` pattern, and
get direction before opening PRs.

Why
---
With `core.multi_team` enabled, each team needs a triggerer started with
`--team-name`, otherwise deferred tasks of that team's Dags never resume
(multi-team.rst, "Triggerer" section). The chart can only render one
triggerer today, so a multi-team deployment on the official chart is
not fully functional without patching templates. Running one dag
processor per team or bundle (`--bundle-name`) is the matching need on
the parsing side, for isolation and sizing.

We run this in production (Airflow 3.3.2, several teams in one instance)
through a wrapper chart that copies the upstream triggerer and dag
processor templates in a loop. I'd rather contribute to it than keep that
copy in sync.

Proposal
--------
triggerer:
  enableDefault: true    # render the unsuffixed triggerer
  teamName: ~            # -> --team-name
  queues: ~              # -> --queues
  extraArgs: []          # appended to the default args
  sets: []               # each item overrides any triggerer.* key
dagProcessor:
  enableDefault: true
  bundleNames: []        # -> repeated --bundle-name
  extraArgs: []
  sets: []

- A set `<n>` renders `<fullname>-<component>-<n>` with its own
  ServiceAccount, PDB and ScaledObject, and a `<component>-set: <n>`
  label. Values merge exactly like worker sets (shared helper).
- Sets reference bundles and teams by name only. Render-time validation
  checks them against dagBundleConfigList, so there is no second list
  to keep in sync (the concern raised on #61039). Users set small scope
  fields instead of a full CLI in `args` (the concern raised on #61963).
- With every new field empty, the output is identical to today's.

Planned as small PRs: shared set helpers (generalising
workersMergeValues), triggerer.sets, dagProcessor.sets, then optional
multi-team conveniences (deriving bundles from team_name, team-aware
KEDA query).

Related: #26494, #61037, #61039, #61963, #64037.

Questions
---------
1. For the dag processor, is a separate `sets` list (referencing
   bundles by name) acceptable, or would you prefer per-bundle overrides
   on the dagBundleConfigList entries (as discussed on #61039)? The
   triggerer is scoped by team, not bundle, so `sets` seems the natural
   fit there either way.
2. Should this target 2.0.0?
3. The default instance's selectors also match set pods (same as worker
   sets today). Worth adding a `<component>-set: default` label to all
   three components while the 2.0 window allows breaking changes?

Thanks,
Mathieu Monet

--
Drafted-by: Claude Code (AI assistant) and
reviewed by me before sending.

messages.subject:
Re: [PROPOSAL] Helm chart: triggerer.sets and dagProcessor.sets
 (per-team instances for multi-team)
messages.body:
Hey Mathieu,

I appreciate you contributing this back! I don't work very closely with
Helm, so I'm not the best candidate to review this proposal, but from a
multi team perspective, I'd really love to have this, especially for
triggerers, where having one per team is critical. I think the proposal
looks reasonable to me. If you haven't already, I'd start putting up some
PRs if you're not getting much traction here.

Cheers,
Niko
